latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(access-log): rewrite access.log in place on cleanup by @narcisonunez in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5885
* fix(schedules): prevent cron jobs from being lost on cloud by @imrja8 in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5542
* fix(terminal): close SSH sessions when the terminal WebSocket closes by @imrja8 in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5874
* fix(security): enforce org/role boundaries across routers, webhooks and auth by @Siumauricio in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5899
* fix(security): cross-organization notification hijack on self-hosted by @Siumauricio in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5925
* fix(security): registry password and deploy webhook token exposed to read-only roles by @Siumauricio in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5924
* fix(security): deployment history exposes registry passwords from rollback snapshots by @Siumauricio in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5923
* fix(security): mounts.update can attach a mount to another organization's service by @Siumauricio in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5920
* fix(security): missing authorization on deployment killProcess/readLogs/remove and compose.readLogs by @Siumauricio in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5917
* fix(security): cross-organization SSH key attachment in server create/update by @Siumauricio in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5916
* fix(security): cross-organization project/environment/service takeover via update, move and duplicate by @Siumauricio in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5915
* fix(security): user.update mass assignment of server-managed fields by @Siumauricio in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5914
* fix(security): getWebServerSettings leaks SSH private key to any user by @Siumauricio in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5913
* fix(security): database changePassword command injection (all 5 DB types) by @Siumauricio in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5910
* fix(security): file mount delete command injection (member → root) by @Siumauricio in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5907
* Update README.md by @Siumauricio in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5905
* fix(onboarding): unblock plan step after starting a trial by @Siumauricio in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5887
* fix(traefik): harden the Traefik update and rollback by @imrja8 in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5881
* fix(security): "Access to API" permission not enforced in user.createApiKey by @Siumauricio in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5964
* fix(security): SSRF via custom template baseUrl for any authenticated user by @Siumauricio in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5966
* fix(security): stored XSS via whitelabeling customCss sanitizer bypass by @Siumauricio in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5930
* fix(security): missing authorization on network management endpoints by @Siumauricio in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5967
* fix(security): schedule appName command injection (member → root) by @Siumauricio in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5906
* fix(security): compose composePath command injection by @Siumauricio in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5912
* fix(security): domain path injected unvalidated into Traefik router rule by @Siumauricio in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5918
* fix(security): path traversal via appName on the docker stats websocket by @Siumauricio in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5928
* fix(security): SSRF through notification webhook URLs by @Siumauricio in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5965
* fix(security): application build fields command injection (member → root) by @Siumauricio in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5911
* fix(security): volume backups can target volumes the service does not own by @Siumauricio in https://github.com/Dokploy/dokploy/pull/5929
* fix(profile): enforce minimum password length on profil

detail.readme:
Join us on Discord for help, feedback, and discussions!


Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service (PaaS) that simplifies the deployment and management of applications and databases. ## ✨ Features Dokploy includes multiple features to make your life easier. - **Applications**: Deploy any type of application (Node.js, PHP, Python, Go, Ruby, etc.). - **Databases**: Create and manage databases with support for MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MariaDB, libsql, and Redis. - **Backups**: Automate backups for databases to an external storage destination. - **Docker Compose**: Native support for Docker Compose to manage complex applications. - **Multi Node**: Scale applications to multiple nodes using Docker Swarm to manage the cluster. - **Templates**: Deploy open-source templates (Plausible, Pocketbase, Calcom, etc.) with a single click +600 Templates. - **Traefik Integration**: Automatically integrates with Traefik for routing and load balancing. - **Real-time Monitoring**: Monitor CPU, memory, storage, and network usage for every resource. - **Logs & Metrics**: Ship container logs and host/container metrics to Grafana (Loki, Prometheus/Mimir), Datadog, New Relic, InfluxDB, VictoriaMetrics, Better Stack, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Splunk, or AWS CloudWatch, tagged by project/environment/application. - **Docker Management**: Easily deploy and manage Docker containers. - **CLI/API**: Manage your applications and databases using the command line or through the API. - **Notifications**: Get notified when your deployments succeed or fail (via Slack, Discord, Telegram, Email, etc.). - **Multi Server**: Deploy and manage your applications remotely to external servers. - **Self-Hosted**: Self-host Dokploy on your VPS. ## 🚀 Getting Started To get started, run the following command on a VPS: Want to skip the installation process? [Try the Dokploy Cloud](https://app.dokploy.com). ```bash curl -sSL https://dokploy.com/install.sh | bash ``` For detailed documentation, visit [docs.dokploy.com](https://docs.dokploy.com). [Github Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/Siumauricio) ### Contributors 🤝 ## 📺 Video Tutorial ## 🤝 Contributing Check out the [Contributing Guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) for more information.
